commonMistakesTr: 'Özellikle' için 'particularly' ya da 'in particular' kullanılır; 'in particularly' yanlıştır.

senses.label: specific one
senses.definitionEn: used to show you mean one exact person, thing or case and not others

examples.en: Is there a particular reason you want to leave early?
examples.tr: Erken çıkmak istemenin belirli bir nedeni var mı?

examples.en: I like all kinds of music, but jazz in particular.
examples.tr: Her tür müziği severim ama özellikle cazı.

examples.en: This particular model is cheaper than the others.
examples.tr: Bu belirli model diğerlerinden daha ucuz.

senses.label: hard to please
senses.definitionEn: caring a lot about details and difficult to satisfy

examples.en: My cat is very particular about her food.
He is particular about how his desk is organized.

commonMistakesTr: 'Invaluable' 'değersiz' değil, 'paha biçilmez' demektir.

senses.label: worth a lot
senses.definitionEn: worth a lot of money or very useful and important

examples.en: Keep your valuable things in the hotel safe.
The internship gave me valuable experience.
examples.tr: Staj bana değerli bir deneyim kazandırdı.

examples.en: Please don't waste my valuable time with jokes.

senses.label: normal, not special
senses.definitionEn: normal and usual, with nothing special or different about it

examples.en: It started as an ordinary Monday morning.
examples.tr: Sıradan bir pazartesi sabahı olarak başladı.

examples.en: Ordinary people can't afford these prices.
Nothing out of the ordinary happened at school today.
examples.tr: Bugün okulda olağan dışı bir şey olmadı.
examples.noteTr: out of the ordinary = olağan dışı

senses.label: bad or important
senses.definitionEn: very bad, important or worrying

examples.en: Climate change is a serious problem for everyone.
examples.tr: İklim değişikliği herkes için ciddi bir sorundur.

examples.en: Luckily, the accident wasn't serious.
Are you serious about moving to Canada?
examples.noteTr: be serious about: ... konusunda ciddi olmak

senses.label: not joking
senses.definitionEn: thinking carefully and meaning what you say, not joking

examples.en: Why do you look so serious today?
examples.tr: Bugün neden bu kadar ciddi görünüyorsun?

examples.en: I'm serious, this is not a joke.

commonMistakesTr: 'Effective' (etkili) ile 'efficient' (verimli, az kaynakla iş gören) farklıdır; karıştırmayın.

senses.label: works well
senses.definitionEn: producing the result that you want

examples.en: Regular practice is the most effective way to learn a language.
examples.tr: Düzenli pratik, bir dil öğrenmenin en etkili yoludur.

examples.en: The new advertising campaign was very effective.
Is this cleaning spray effective on glass?
examples.tr: Bu temizlik spreyi camda etkili mi?

commonMistakesTr: 'Başarılı olmak' için 'be successful' denir; 'success' bir isimdir, 'I success' yanlıştır, doğrusu 'I succeed'.

senses.label: achieving aims
senses.definitionEn: achieving what you wanted or planned, or becoming rich and famous

examples.en: Her first book was very successful.
They were successful in finding a new office.
examples.tr: Yeni bir ofis bulmakta başarılı oldular.

examples.en: He runs a successful restaurant in the city centre.
examples.tr: Şehir merkezinde başarılı bir restoran işletiyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'Responsible of' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'responsible for'.

senses.label: in charge of
senses.definitionEn: having the duty of looking after someone or something, or being the cause of something

examples.en: Who is responsible for this project?
I'm responsible for feeding the dog every morning.
examples.tr: Her sabah köpeği beslemekten ben sorumluyum.

examples.en: The storm was responsible for the power cut.

senses.label: can be trusted
senses.definitionEn: sensible and able to be trusted to do the right thing

examples.en: She is a very responsible babysitter.
examples.tr: O çok sorumluluk sahibi bir bebek bakıcısı.

examples.en: You need to be more responsible with money.
examples.tr: Para konusunda daha sorumlu olman gerekiyor.

commonMistakesTr: Telaffuzda ortadaki 'for' çoğunlukla okunmaz: /ˈkʌmftərbəl/, 'kom-for-tey-bıl' değil.

senses.label: pleasant and relaxed
senses.definitionEn: making you feel physically relaxed, or feeling relaxed yourself

examples.en: This sofa is really comfortable.
I don't feel comfortable speaking in front of large groups.
examples.tr: Büyük grupların önünde konuşurken rahat hissetmiyorum.

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.

senses.label: natural world
senses.definitionEn: the air, water, land, plants and animals around us

examples.en: Plastic bags are bad for the environment.
examples.noteTr: the environment: genel olarak doğa, 'the' ile kullanılır

examples.en: We should all do more to protect the environment.
examples.tr: Hepimiz çevreyi korumak için daha fazlasını yapmalıyız.

examples.en: Factories near the river are damaging the environment.
examples.tr: Nehrin yakınındaki fabrikalar çevreye zarar veriyor.

senses.label: conditions around you
senses.definitionEn: the conditions and situation in which you live or work

examples.en: The office has a friendly working environment.
examples.tr: Ofisin samimi bir çalışma ortamı var.

examples.en: Children need a safe environment to grow up in.
examples.tr: Çocukların büyümek için güvenli bir ortama ihtiyacı var.

commonMistakesTr: 'Weather' sayılamaz: 'a nice weather' değil, 'nice weather' denir; 'whether' (-ip -ipmediği) ile de karıştırılır.

senses.label: conditions outside
senses.definitionEn: how hot, cold, wet, windy or sunny it is outside at a certain time

examples.en: The weather is lovely today.
What's the weather like in Izmir in April?
examples.noteTr: What's the weather like? = Hava nasıl?

examples.en: Let's check the weather forecast before the picnic.

commonMistakesTr: 'Travel' genelde fiildir; tek bir yolculuk için isim olarak 'a travel' değil 'a trip' ya da 'a journey' denir.

senses.label: go to places
senses.definitionEn: to go from one place to another, especially far away

examples.en: I love to travel in the summer.
We travelled by train from Ankara to Istanbul.
examples.noteTr: travel by + ulaşım aracı (by bus, by car)

examples.en: Have you ever travelled abroad?
examples.tr: Hiç yurt dışına seyahat ettin mi?

commonMistakesTr: 'Arrive to' yanlıştır; şehir/ülke için 'arrive in', bina/yer için 'arrive at' kullanılır. 'Arrive home' edatsızdır.

senses.label: reach a place
senses.definitionEn: to reach a place at the end of a journey

examples.en: What time does the train arrive?
We arrived in Rome late at night.
Please arrive at the office before nine.

senses.label: leave a place
senses.definitionEn: to leave a place, especially to start a journey

examples.en: The flight to London departs at 6:30.
examples.noteTr: Tarifeli olaylar için geniş zaman kullanılır.

examples.en: Our bus departed from the main square.
Trains to the airport depart every fifteen minutes.
examples.tr: Havalimanı trenleri her on beş dakikada bir kalkıyor.

collocations: pick someone up from the airport

senses.label: place for planes
senses.definitionEn: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers

examples.en: I'll meet you at the airport.
How long does it take to get to the airport?
We waited at airport security for an hour.

senses.label: place for trains or buses
senses.definitionEn: a building where trains or buses stop so people can get on and off

examples.en: The station is a ten-minute walk from here.
examples.tr: İstasyon buradan on dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde.

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest metro station?
examples.tr: Affedersiniz, en yakın metro istasyonu nerede?
examples.noteTr: Yol sormak için kalıp: Where is the nearest ...?

examples.en: I'll pick you up at the bus station.

senses.label: building for a service
senses.definitionEn: a building used for a particular service, such as police or fire

examples.en: They reported the stolen bike at the police station.
The fire station is next to the school.

senses.label: line between countries
senses.definitionEn: the line that divides two countries or areas

examples.en: We crossed the border into Georgia in the morning.
There was a long queue at border control.
examples.tr: Sınır kontrolünde uzun bir kuyruk vardı.

examples.en: The town lies on the border between two countries.
examples.tr: Kasaba iki ülke arasındaki sınırda yer alıyor.

senses.label: edge
senses.definitionEn: a strip or line around the edge of something

examples.en: The plate has a blue border.
Add a thin border around the photo.
examples.tr: Fotoğrafın etrafına ince bir çerçeve ekle.

senses.label: way towards a place
senses.definitionEn: the way something or someone is moving or facing

examples.en: I think we're going in the wrong direction.
examples.noteTr: in the wrong direction: yanlış yönde

examples.en: Which direction is the beach?
The wind changed direction during the night.

senses.label: instructions
senses.definitionEn: information about how to get somewhere or how to do something

examples.en: Can you give me directions to the museum?
examples.tr: Bana müzeye nasıl gidileceğini tarif edebilir misiniz?
examples.noteTr: Yol tarifi anlamında genelde çoğul: directions

examples.en: Read the directions before you use the machine.

commonMistakesTr: 'Traffic' sayılamaz: 'a heavy traffic' ya da 'many traffics' değil, 'heavy traffic' / 'a lot of traffic' denir.

senses.label: vehicles on roads
senses.definitionEn: the cars, buses and other vehicles moving on roads at one time

examples.en: Sorry I'm late, I was stuck in traffic.
examples.tr: Geç kaldığım için üzgünüm, trafiğe takıldım.

examples.en: There is always heavy traffic on this road in the evening.
examples.tr: Bu yolda akşamları her zaman yoğun trafik olur.

examples.en: The traffic lights turned red.

commonMistakesTr: Telaffuzda 'h' okunmaz: /ˈviːɪkəl/.

senses.label: machine for transport
senses.definitionEn: a machine such as a car, bus or truck that carries people or goods

examples.en: No vehicles are allowed in the old town.
Electric vehicles are becoming more popular.
examples.tr: Elektrikli araçlar giderek daha popüler oluyor.
examples.noteTr: become more popular: daha popüler olmak

examples.en: Please do not leave your vehicle in front of the gate.

senses.label: road in a town
senses.definitionEn: a public road in a city or town with buildings along it

examples.en: I live on a quiet street near the park.
examples.tr: Parkın yakınında sessiz bir sokakta oturuyorum.
examples.noteTr: on a street: bir sokakta (İng. 'in' da olur)

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
examples.tr: Karşıdan karşıya geçmeden önce iki tarafa da bak.

examples.en: Which street is the bakery on?

senses.label: structure with walls
senses.definitionEn: a structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school or office

examples.en: Our office is in that tall glass building.
This building is more than two hundred years old.
examples.tr: Bu bina iki yüz yıldan daha eski.

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed inside the building.
examples.noteTr: is not allowed: izin verilmez, yasaktır

senses.label: area where people live
senses.definitionEn: a part of a town and the people who live there

examples.en: We moved to a quiet neighbourhood last year.
examples.tr: Geçen yıl sessiz bir mahalleye taşındık.

examples.en: Is there a good bakery in the neighbourhood?
examples.tr: Civarda iyi bir fırın var mı?

examples.en: Everyone in my neighbourhood knows each other.

senses.label: place to eat
senses.definitionEn: a place where you buy and eat a meal

examples.en: Let's try the new fish restaurant by the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarındaki yeni balık restoranını deneyelim.

examples.en: Can you recommend a good restaurant near here?
examples.tr: Buralarda iyi bir restoran önerebilir misiniz?

examples.en: My uncle owns a small restaurant in Bursa.
examples.tr: Amcamın Bursa'da küçük bir lokantası var.

senses.label: list of food
senses.definitionEn: a list of the food and drinks you can order in a restaurant

examples.en: Could we see the menu, please?
There are three vegetarian dishes on the menu.
The lunch menu changes every week.
examples.tr: Öğle yemeği menüsü her hafta değişiyor.

senses.label: computer options
senses.definitionEn: a list of choices shown on a computer or phone screen

examples.en: Click the settings icon to open the menu.
examples.tr: Menüyü açmak için ayarlar simgesine tıkla.

examples.en: You can change the language from the main menu.

commonMistakesTr: Restoranda 'hesap' için 'account' denmez; 'bill' (İng.) ya da 'check' (ABD) kullanılır.

senses.label: amount to pay
senses.definitionEn: a piece of paper showing how much you must pay for something

examples.en: Excuse me, can we have the bill, please?
Let's split the bill between the four of us.
Our electricity bill was very high this winter.
examples.tr: Bu kış elektrik faturamız çok yüksekti.

senses.label: paper money (US)
senses.definitionEn: a piece of paper money, mainly in American English

examples.en: He paid with a twenty-dollar bill.
I only have a fifty-dollar bill, sorry.
examples.tr: Üzgünüm, sadece elli dolarlık bir banknotum var.

commonMistakesTr: 'p' harfi okunmaz: /rɪˈsiːt/. 'Recipe' (yemek tarifi) ile karıştırılmamalı.

senses.label: proof of payment
senses.definitionEn: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something

examples.en: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
examples.tr: İade etmek istersen diye fişi sakla.

examples.en: Can I have a receipt, please?
Send your taxi receipts to the finance team.

commonMistakesTr: 'Pahalı fiyat' denmez: 'expensive price' değil, 'high price' denir; 'expensive' ürün için kullanılır.

senses.label: money needed to buy
senses.definitionEn: the amount of money you have to pay to buy something

examples.en: What's the price of this jacket?
Food prices have gone up again.
Everything in the shop is half price today.
examples.tr: Bugün mağazadaki her şey yarı fiyatına.

commonMistakesTr: Fiil olarak 'cost' düzensizdir: cost - cost - cost; 'costed' denmez.

senses.label: amount paid
senses.definitionEn: the amount of money needed to buy, make or do something

examples.en: The cost of living in big cities is very high.
examples.tr: Büyük şehirlerde hayat pahalılığı çok yüksek.
examples.noteTr: the cost of living: geçim maliyeti, hayat pahalılığı

examples.en: Breakfast is included at no extra cost.
We need to reduce our energy costs this year.
examples.tr: Bu yıl enerji maliyetlerimizi düşürmemiz gerekiyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'Discount yapmak' için 'make a discount' yerine 'give/offer a discount' denir.

senses.label: lower price
senses.definitionEn: an amount taken off the usual price

examples.en: Students get a twenty percent discount at the cinema.
examples.tr: Öğrenciler sinemada yüzde yirmi indirim alıyor.

examples.en: Is there a discount if I buy two?
examples.tr: İki tane alırsam indirim var mı?

examples.en: We offer a special discount to regular customers.

grammarNoteTr: isim olarak da kullanılır: make a purchase (alışveriş yapmak)

senses.label: buy
senses.definitionEn: to buy something, used in more formal situations

examples.en: Tickets can be purchased online or at the door.
examples.tr: Biletler internetten ya da kapıda satın alınabilir.

examples.en: The company purchased three new trucks last month.
examples.tr: Şirket geçen ay üç yeni kamyon satın aldı.

examples.en: You must purchase a ticket before you board the train.
examples.tr: Trene binmeden önce bilet satın almalısınız.

commonMistakesTr: 'Return back' gereksiz tekrardır; sadece 'return' yeterlidir.

senses.label: come or go back
senses.definitionEn: to come or go back to a place

examples.en: She returned home after ten years abroad.
examples.tr: Yurt dışında on yıl geçirdikten sonra eve döndü.

examples.en: When will you return from your holiday?
The manager will return to the office at two.

senses.label: give or send back
senses.definitionEn: to give, put or send something back

examples.en: I need to return these shoes because they're too small.
examples.tr: Bu ayakkabıları iade etmem gerekiyor çünkü çok küçükler.

examples.en: Please return the library books by Friday.
examples.tr: Lütfen kütüphane kitaplarını cumaya kadar iade edin.

senses.label: give and receive
senses.definitionEn: to give something and get something else in return

examples.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a bigger size?
examples.tr: Bu gömleği daha büyük bir bedenle değiştirebilir miyim?
examples.noteTr: exchange A for B: A'yı B ile değiştirmek

examples.en: We exchanged phone numbers after the meeting.
You can exchange money at the airport, but the rate is bad.
examples.tr: Havalimanında para bozdurabilirsin ama kur kötü.

senses.label: how big
senses.definitionEn: how big or small something is, or a standard measure for clothes and shoes

examples.en: What size shoes do you wear?
Do you have this dress in a smaller size?
examples.tr: Bu elbisenin daha küçük bedeni var mı?

examples.en: The two rooms are the same size.

commonMistakesTr: 'What colour is it?' doğrudur; 'Which colour it is?' gibi soru düzeni yanlıştır.

senses.label: red, blue, etc.
senses.definitionEn: the quality of something being red, blue, green and so on

examples.en: What's your favourite colour for a car?
examples.tr: Araba için en sevdiğin renk ne?

examples.en: I love the bright colours of this painting.
The leaves change colour in autumn.

commonMistakesTr: 'Clothes' tekil hali yoktur; 'a clothes' denmez. Tek parça için 'a piece of clothing' ya da 'a shirt' gibi denir.

senses.label: things you wear
senses.definitionEn: things such as shirts, trousers and dresses that you wear on your body

examples.en: I need to buy some new clothes for work.
examples.tr: İş için birkaç yeni kıyafet almam gerekiyor.

examples.en: Take off your wet clothes and have a hot shower.
examples.tr: Islak kıyafetlerini çıkar ve sıcak bir duş al.

examples.en: Her clothes are always neat and clean.
examples.tr: Onun kıyafetleri her zaman düzenli ve temizdir.
examples.noteTr: clothes her zaman çoğuldur: clothes are

commonMistakesTr: Türkçede 'ayakkabım' tekil olsa da İngilizcede genelde çoğul 'my shoes' denir.
grammarNoteTr: tekil: shoe, bir çift: a pair of shoes

senses.label: things worn on feet
senses.definitionEn: things you wear on your feet, usually made of leather or plastic

examples.en: Take off your shoes before you come in.
I bought a new pair of running shoes.
examples.tr: Yeni bir çift koşu ayakkabısı aldım.

examples.en: These shoes hurt my feet.

commonMistakesTr: Arkadaşla buluşma için 'appointment' değil 'plans' ya da 'meet' kullanılır; 'appointment' resmî randevudur.

senses.label: arranged meeting
senses.definitionEn: an arrangement to meet someone at a certain time, often for a professional service

examples.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the dentist.
I have a doctor's appointment at ten tomorrow.
examples.tr: Yarın saat onda doktor randevum var.

examples.en: Can we move our appointment to Thursday?

commonMistakesTr: 'İlaç içmek' birebir 'drink medicine' değil, 'take medicine' olarak söylenir.

senses.label: drug for illness
senses.definitionEn: something you take to treat an illness or feel better

examples.en: Don't forget to take your medicine after dinner.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeğinden sonra ilacını almayı unutma.

examples.en: Keep all medicine away from small children.
examples.tr: Tüm ilaçları küçük çocuklardan uzak tutun.

examples.en: The pharmacist gave me some cough medicine.

senses.label: study of treating illness
senses.definitionEn: the science and study of treating and preventing illness

examples.en: My sister is studying medicine at university.
Modern medicine has changed a lot in fifty years.
examples.tr: Modern tıp elli yılda çok değişti.

senses.label: hurting feeling
senses.definitionEn: the feeling you have when part of your body hurts

examples.en: I have a terrible pain in my back.
He was in a lot of pain after the fall.
Does the pain get worse at night?

senses.label: annoying person or thing
senses.definitionEn: an annoying person or thing, used informally

examples.en: Finding a parking space here is such a pain.
examples.tr: Burada park yeri bulmak tam bir dert.

examples.en: My little brother can be a real pain sometimes.
examples.tr: Küçük kardeşim bazen tam bir baş belası olabiliyor.

senses.label: place for sick people
senses.definitionEn: a place where sick or injured people are treated by doctors and nurses

examples.en: My grandfather is in hospital this week.
They took her to hospital in an ambulance.
Which hospital was your baby born in?

senses.label: shop for medicine
senses.definitionEn: a shop where medicines are prepared and sold

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy open on Sundays?
examples.tr: Pazar günleri açık eczane var mı?

examples.en: I picked up my prescription from the pharmacy.
The pharmacy on the corner closes at eight.

senses.label: sudden dangerous situation
senses.definitionEn: a sudden, serious and dangerous situation that needs action quickly

examples.en: In an emergency, call 112.
Please keep the emergency exit clear.
Sorry, I have to leave, it's a family emergency.
examples.tr: Üzgünüm, gitmem lazım, ailevi bir acil durum var.

commonMistakesTr: 'Advice' sayılamaz: 'an advice' ya da 'advices' denmez. Fiili 'advise' (/z/ ile) şeklindedir.

senses.label: helpful opinion
senses.definitionEn: an opinion someone gives you about what you should do

examples.en: Can I ask you for some advice?
My teacher gave me some good advice about exams.
examples.tr: Öğretmenim bana sınavlar hakkında iyi tavsiyeler verdi.

examples.en: Let me give you a piece of advice: save money.
examples.tr: Sana bir tavsiye vereyim: para biriktir.
examples.noteTr: Tek tavsiye: a piece of advice

senses.label: physical activity
senses.definitionEn: physical activity you do to stay strong and fit

examples.en: I try to do some exercise every morning.
examples.tr: Her sabah biraz egzersiz yapmaya çalışıyorum.

examples.en: Regular exercise helps you sleep better.
examples.tr: Düzenli egzersiz daha iyi uyumana yardımcı olur.

examples.en: You don't get enough exercise, do you?

senses.label: practice task
senses.definitionEn: a piece of work that helps you practise something you are learning

examples.en: Please finish exercise four for homework.
examples.tr: Lütfen ödev olarak dördüncü alıştırmayı bitirin.

examples.en: This grammar exercise was quite difficult.

senses.label: thing you often do
senses.definitionEn: something you do often and regularly, often without thinking

examples.en: Biting your nails is a bad habit.
I'm trying to break the habit of checking my phone in bed.
examples.tr: Yatakta telefonuma bakma alışkanlığından kurtulmaya çalışıyorum.

examples.en: He still wakes up at six out of habit.

commonMistakesTr: 'Uyumaya gitmek' için 'go to sleep' ya da 'go to bed' denir; 'go to sleeping' yanlıştır.

senses.label: rest with eyes closed
senses.definitionEn: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind not awake

examples.en: Did you sleep well last night?
The baby usually sleeps for two hours after lunch.
examples.tr: Bebek genelde öğle yemeğinden sonra iki saat uyur.

examples.en: I couldn't sleep because of the noise.

commonMistakesTr: Öğün isimleri genelde 'the' almaz: 'have the breakfast' değil 'have breakfast'.

senses.label: morning meal
senses.definitionEn: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

examples.en: What did you have for breakfast?
We have breakfast together on Sundays.
Never skip breakfast before an exam.

senses.label: midday meal
senses.definitionEn: a meal eaten in the middle of the day

examples.en: Let's have lunch together tomorrow.
I usually eat a sandwich for lunch.
Our lunch break is only thirty minutes.

senses.label: evening meal
senses.definitionEn: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

examples.en: What are we having for dinner tonight?
My dad cooks dinner on Fridays.
examples.tr: Cuma günleri akşam yemeğini babam pişirir.

examples.en: They invited us to dinner at their new flat.
examples.tr: Bizi yeni dairelerine akşam yemeğine davet ettiler.
examples.noteTr: invite to dinner: yemeğe davet etmek

senses.label: food in a dish
senses.definitionEn: one of the foods you mix together to make a dish

examples.en: You only need four ingredients for this cake.
examples.tr: Bu kek için sadece dört malzemeye ihtiyacın var.

examples.en: Fresh ingredients make the food taste better.
examples.tr: Taze malzemeler yemeğin tadını daha güzel yapar.

examples.en: Tomatoes are the main ingredient in this sauce.

senses.label: part of success
senses.definitionEn: one of the things that makes something successful

examples.en: Trust is an important ingredient of a good team.
examples.tr: Güven, iyi bir takımın önemli bir unsurudur.

examples.en: Hard work is the secret ingredient of her success.
examples.tr: Sıkı çalışma onun başarısının gizli unsurudur.

commonMistakesTr: Sondaki 'e' okunur: /ˈresəpi/. 'Receipt' (fiş) ile karıştırılmamalı.

senses.label: cooking instructions
senses.definitionEn: instructions that tell you how to cook a dish

examples.en: Can you send me the recipe for this soup?
examples.tr: Bu çorbanın tarifini bana gönderebilir misin?

examples.en: I followed the recipe exactly, but the cake didn't rise.
examples.tr: Tarifi aynen uyguladım ama kek kabarmadı.

examples.en: This is my grandmother's secret recipe.

commonMistakesTr: 'Very delicious' yerine 'absolutely delicious' ya da sadece 'delicious' daha doğaldır, çünkü kelime zaten güçlüdür.

senses.label: very tasty
senses.definitionEn: having a very pleasant taste or smell

examples.en: Thank you, the dinner was delicious!
Something smells delicious in the kitchen.
These strawberries are absolutely delicious.

commonMistakesTr: 'I thirst' denmez; 'susadım' için 'I'm thirsty' kullanılır.

senses.label: needing a drink
senses.definitionEn: needing or wanting to drink something

examples.en: I'm really thirsty. Is there any water?
examples.tr: Çok susadım. Hiç su var mı?

examples.en: Running in the sun always makes me thirsty.
Are the children thirsty after the game?

commonMistakesTr: 'Health' isimdir (sağlık), 'healthy' sıfattır: 'health food' ve 'healthy food' farklı kalıplardır.

senses.label: good for the body
senses.definitionEn: physically strong and well, or good for your body

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are healthy snacks.
She walks to work to stay healthy.
examples.tr: Sağlıklı kalmak için işe yürüyerek gidiyor.

examples.en: Is it healthy to drink coffee every day?
examples.tr: Her gün kahve içmek sağlıklı mı?

senses.label: bad for the body
senses.definitionEn: not good for your health, or not physically well

examples.en: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.
He has some very unhealthy habits.
Fast food is cheap, but it's often unhealthy.
examples.tr: Fast food ucuz ama çoğu zaman sağlıksız.

commonMistakesTr: 'Relation' daha resmî ve genel bağlantıdır; romantik ya da kişisel ilişki için 'relationship' kullanılır.

senses.label: connection between people
senses.definitionEn: the way two or more people or things are connected or behave towards each other

examples.en: I have a good relationship with my parents.
Is she in a relationship right now?
examples.tr: Şu an bir ilişkisi var mı?
examples.noteTr: be in a relationship: birisiyle birlikte olmak

examples.en: Scientists studied the relationship between sleep and memory.
examples.tr: Bilim insanları uyku ve hafıza arasındaki ilişkiyi inceledi.

senses.label: person in charge
senses.definitionEn: a person who controls or organizes a business, team or department

examples.en: I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
She became a sales manager at thirty.
My manager lets me work from home on Fridays.
examples.tr: Müdürüm cumaları evden çalışmama izin veriyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'Employee' (çalışan) ile 'employer' (işveren) sık karıştırılır.

senses.label: person paid to work
senses.definitionEn: someone who is paid to work for a person or company

examples.en: The company has about five hundred employees.
examples.tr: Şirketin yaklaşık beş yüz çalışanı var.

examples.en: All new employees must attend the training day.
examples.tr: Tüm yeni çalışanların eğitim gününe katılması gerekiyor.

examples.en: He's been a loyal employee for twenty years.

commonMistakesTr: 'Employer' (işveren) ile 'employee' (çalışan) sık karıştırılır.

senses.label: person or company who gives work
senses.definitionEn: a person or company that pays people to work for them

examples.en: My employer pays for my English lessons.
The hospital is the biggest employer in the town.
Did your employer give you a pay rise this year?
examples.tr: İşverenin bu yıl sana zam yaptı mı?

senses.label: piece of work
senses.definitionEn: a piece of work that you have to do

examples.en: My first task each morning is to check emails.
examples.tr: Her sabah ilk işim e-postaları kontrol etmek.

examples.en: Cleaning the whole house is not an easy task.
examples.tr: Bütün evi temizlemek kolay bir iş değil.

examples.en: Please complete the task before the end of the lesson.
examples.noteTr: complete a task: bir görevi tamamlamak

commonMistakesTr: Fiil olarak (yansıtmak) vurgu ikinci hecededir: /prəˈdʒekt/; isimde ilk hecededir.

senses.label: planned piece of work
senses.definitionEn: a planned piece of work that has a clear aim and takes time to finish

examples.en: We're working on a new project for a bank.
examples.tr: Bir banka için yeni bir proje üzerinde çalışıyoruz.

examples.en: Our class did a project about recycling.
examples.tr: Sınıfımız geri dönüşüm hakkında bir proje yaptı.

examples.en: How long will the project take?

grammarNoteTr: fiil olarak: report something to someone (bildirmek)

senses.label: written description
senses.definitionEn: a written or spoken description of a situation, event or piece of work

examples.en: I have to finish this report by Monday.
examples.tr: Bu raporu pazartesiye kadar bitirmem gerekiyor.

examples.en: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
examples.tr: Hava durumu raporuna göre yarın yağmur yağacak.

examples.en: The report shows that sales fell last year.
examples.tr: Rapor, satışların geçen yıl düştüğünü gösteriyor.

senses.label: school results (UK)
senses.definitionEn: a document from school about a student's work and progress

examples.en: My son got a great school report this term.
examples.tr: Oğlum bu dönem harika bir karne aldı.

examples.en: Parents receive the report at the end of each term.
examples.tr: Veliler karneyi her dönemin sonunda alır.

senses.label: how good something is
senses.definitionEn: how good or bad something is

examples.en: These shoes are expensive, but the quality is excellent.
examples.tr: Bu ayakkabılar pahalı ama kalitesi mükemmel.

examples.en: We only use high quality materials.
Clean air improves our quality of life.

senses.label: characteristic
senses.definitionEn: a feature of someone's character

examples.en: Patience is her best quality.
What qualities does a good leader need?
examples.tr: İyi bir liderin hangi özelliklere ihtiyacı vardır?

senses.label: how well you do
senses.definitionEn: how well a person, machine or company does a job or activity

examples.en: Her performance at work has improved a lot.
This phone's performance is better than the old one.
examples.tr: Bu telefonun performansı eskisinden daha iyi.

examples.en: The team's performance in the final was disappointing.
examples.tr: Takımın finaldeki performansı hayal kırıklığı yarattı.

senses.label: show on stage
senses.definitionEn: an act of playing music, acting or dancing in front of an audience

examples.en: We watched a live performance of the play last night.
examples.tr: Dün akşam oyunun canlı bir temsilini izledik.

examples.en: The band's performance lasted two hours.
examples.tr: Grubun sahne performansı iki saat sürdü.

senses.label: getting better
senses.definitionEn: the act of becoming better, or a change that makes something better

examples.en: There's been a big improvement in your English.
Your essay is good, but there is still room for improvement.
examples.tr: Makalen iyi ama hâlâ geliştirilecek yönleri var.
examples.noteTr: room for improvement: geliştirmeye açık yer

examples.en: We made several improvements to the website.

senses.label: thing that is needed
senses.definitionEn: something that you must have or do because a rule or situation says so

examples.en: A university degree is a requirement for this job.
examples.tr: Bu iş için üniversite diploması şarttır.

examples.en: Does my passport meet the visa requirements?
The building does not meet the new safety requirements.

senses.label: formal deal
senses.definitionEn: a decision or arrangement that two or more people or groups accept

examples.en: The two companies signed an agreement yesterday.
examples.tr: İki şirket dün bir anlaşma imzaladı.

examples.en: After hours of talks, they finally reached an agreement.
examples.tr: Saatler süren görüşmelerin ardından sonunda anlaşmaya vardılar.

examples.en: Is there a written agreement about the rent?
examples.tr: Kira hakkında yazılı bir sözleşme var mı?

senses.label: same opinion
senses.definitionEn: the situation in which people have the same opinion

examples.en: We are all in agreement about the new plan.
She nodded in agreement when I explained my idea.

senses.label: money paid
senses.definitionEn: an amount of money that is paid, or the act of paying

examples.en: We accept payment by card or cash.
examples.tr: Kartla ya da nakit ödeme kabul ediyoruz.

examples.en: I make a car payment every month.
Has the payment arrived in your account yet?

commonMistakesTr: 'Gelir kazanmak' için 'win income' değil, 'earn an income' denir.

senses.label: money you receive
senses.definitionEn: money that you earn from work or receive from other sources

examples.en: Rent takes almost half of my monthly income.
examples.tr: Kira aylık gelirimin neredeyse yarısını alıyor.

examples.en: Families on a low income get extra help.
examples.tr: Düşük gelirli aileler ek yardım alıyor.
examples.noteTr: on a low income: düşük gelirli

examples.en: Tourism is the main source of income for the island.

senses.label: money spent
senses.definitionEn: money that you spend on something

examples.en: The company pays all travel expenses.
examples.noteTr: İş masrafları anlamında genelde çoğul: expenses

examples.en: A car is a big expense for a student.
examples.tr: Araba bir öğrenci için büyük bir masraf.

examples.en: Write down all your monthly expenses in a list.
examples.tr: Tüm aylık giderlerini bir listeye yaz.

commonMistakesTr: 'Loss' isimdir, 'lose' fiildir, 'loose' ise 'gevşek' demektir; üçü sık karıştırılır.

senses.label: losing something
senses.definitionEn: the fact of no longer having something or someone

examples.en: The loss of his job was very hard for him.
examples.tr: İşini kaybetmek onun için çok zor oldu.

examples.en: Lack of sleep can cause memory loss.
Losing the final was a big loss for the team.
examples.tr: Finali kaybetmek takım için büyük bir kayıptı.

senses.label: money lost by a business
senses.definitionEn: money that a business loses because it spends more than it earns

examples.en: The shop made a loss in its first year.
The airline reported huge losses this year.
examples.tr: Havayolu bu yıl büyük zarar açıkladı.

senses.label: thing made to sell
senses.definitionEn: something that is made or grown to be sold

examples.en: The company will launch a new product next month.
examples.tr: Şirket gelecek ay yeni bir ürün piyasaya sürecek.
examples.noteTr: launch a product: ürün piyasaya sürmek

examples.en: Milk, cheese and yoghurt are dairy products.
examples.tr: Süt, peynir ve yoğurt süt ürünleridir.

examples.en: Are these products made in Turkey?

senses.label: bringing goods
senses.definitionEn: the act of taking goods or letters to the place they are sent to

examples.en: Delivery is free for orders over 500 lira.
When is the delivery date for my order?
We're waiting for a delivery from the factory.

senses.label: building for storing goods
senses.definitionEn: a large building where goods are stored before they are sold or sent

examples.en: All the boxes are kept in the warehouse.
My brother works night shifts at a warehouse.
examples.tr: Ağabeyim bir depoda gece vardiyasında çalışıyor.

examples.en: The old warehouse was turned into a modern art gallery.
examples.tr: Eski depo modern bir sanat galerisine dönüştürüldü.

senses.label: goods available
senses.definitionEn: the goods that a shop or company has available to sell

examples.en: Sorry, this item is out of stock.
Do you have these boots in stock in size 40?
examples.tr: Bu botların 40 numarası stokta var mı?

examples.en: We need to check our stock before the holiday season.
examples.tr: Tatil sezonundan önce stoğumuzu kontrol etmemiz gerekiyor.

senses.label: shares in a company
senses.definitionEn: a share of a company that people can buy and sell

examples.en: She invested her savings in stocks.
The stock market fell sharply this morning.

commonMistakesTr: 'Complaint' isimdir; fiil 'complain' olur: 'I complained about it' doğrudur, 'I complainted' yanlıştır.

senses.label: saying you are unhappy
senses.definitionEn: a statement that something is wrong or not good enough

examples.en: I'd like to make a complaint about the noise.
examples.noteTr: make a complaint about: ... hakkında şikâyet etmek

examples.en: We received many complaints about the slow service.
examples.tr: Yavaş hizmetle ilgili birçok şikâyet aldık.

examples.en: Is there a complaint form at reception?

senses.label: needing quick action
senses.definitionEn: so important that it needs action immediately

examples.en: I have an urgent message for the manager.
examples.tr: Müdür için acil bir mesajım var.

examples.en: Is it urgent, or can it wait until tomorrow?
examples.tr: Acil mi, yoksa yarına kadar bekleyebilir mi?

examples.en: The village is in urgent need of clean water.
examples.tr: Köyün acilen temiz suya ihtiyacı var.
examples.noteTr: in urgent need of: acil ihtiyaç içinde

senses.label: say something is certain
senses.definitionEn: to say or show that something is true or will definitely happen

examples.en: Please confirm your booking by email.
Can you confirm the time of the meeting?
The doctor confirmed that my arm wasn't broken.

commonMistakesTr: 'Inform to someone' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'inform someone'.

senses.label: tell officially
senses.definitionEn: to tell someone about something, especially in a formal way

examples.en: Please inform us if you change your address.
They informed the police about the stolen car.
I'll keep you informed about any changes.
examples.tr: Herhangi bir değişiklikten seni haberdar edeceğim.

commonMistakesTr: 'Contact with someone' fiil olarak yanlıştır; doğrusu 'contact someone'. İsimde 'be in contact with' denir.

senses.label: communicate with
senses.definitionEn: to call, write to or email someone

examples.en: Please contact me if you have any questions.
examples.tr: Herhangi bir sorunuz olursa lütfen benimle iletişime geçin.

examples.en: I tried to contact her, but her phone was off.
examples.tr: Ona ulaşmaya çalıştım ama telefonu kapalıydı.

examples.en: How can I contact the hotel directly?

senses.label: asking politely
senses.definitionEn: an act of asking for something politely or formally

examples.en: We received your request for more information.
Can I make a special request for the band?
examples.tr: Grup için özel bir şarkı isteğinde bulunabilir miyim?

examples.en: Vegetarian meals are available on request.

commonMistakesTr: 'Reply my email' yanlıştır; 'reply to my email' denir (oysa 'answer my email' edatsızdır).

senses.label: answer
senses.definitionEn: to answer someone by saying or writing something

examples.en: I'm sorry I didn't reply to your message sooner.
examples.tr: Mesajına daha önce cevap vermediğim için üzgünüm.

examples.en: She replied that she was too busy.
examples.tr: Çok meşgul olduğunu söyleyerek yanıt verdi.

examples.en: He still hasn't replied to my email.

senses.label: add a file
senses.definitionEn: to add a document or file to an email

examples.en: I've attached my CV to this email.
Don't forget to attach the photos.
Did you attach the invoice to the message?

senses.label: fix to something
senses.definitionEn: to fasten or join one thing to another

examples.en: Attach the label to your suitcase.
The shelf is attached to the wall with screws.

commonMistakesTr: 'Look forward to' kalıbından sonra '-ing' gelir: 'look forward to seeing you', 'to see' değil.

senses.label: send on to someone else
senses.definitionEn: to send a letter, email or message you received to another person

examples.en: Could you forward me the email from the client?
examples.tr: Müşteriden gelen e-postayı bana iletebilir misin?

examples.en: I forwarded your question to our technical team.
Please don't forward this message to anyone.

commonMistakesTr: Türkçedeki '-den özür dilemek' yüzünden 'apologize from' denir; doğrusu 'apologize to someone'.

senses.label: say sorry
senses.definitionEn: to tell someone that you are sorry for something you did

examples.en: I apologize for being late.
You should apologize to your sister.
The airline apologized for the delay.
examples.tr: Havayolu şirketi rötar için özür diledi.

senses.label: make clearer
senses.definitionEn: to make something easier to understand by explaining it more

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean by that?
examples.tr: Bununla ne demek istediğini açıklar mısın?

examples.en: The teacher clarified the rules before the exam.
I'd like to clarify one point in the contract.
examples.tr: Sözleşmedeki bir noktayı açıklığa kavuşturmak istiyorum.

senses.label: finish doing
senses.definitionEn: to finish doing something, or to write all the information on a form

examples.en: Please complete the form in black ink.
She completed the marathon in under four hours.
examples.tr: Maratonu dört saatten kısa sürede tamamladı.

examples.en: The new bridge will be completed next year.
examples.noteTr: will be + V3: gelecek zaman edilgen

commonMistakesTr: 'Finish' kalıbından sonra '-ing' gelir: 'finish reading', 'finish to read' değil.

senses.label: come to the end
senses.definitionEn: to do the last part of something so it is done, or to come to an end

examples.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
I finish work at six every day.
examples.tr: Her gün saat altıda işten çıkarım.
examples.noteTr: finish work: işi bitirmek, mesaiden çıkmak

examples.en: The film finished at midnight.

senses.label: look at again
senses.definitionEn: to look at or think about something again carefully, often to change it

examples.en: Let's review the plan before we send it.
I always review my notes the night before a test.
examples.tr: Sınavdan önceki akşam her zaman notlarımı gözden geçiririm.

examples.en: The school is reviewing its rules on mobile phones.
examples.tr: Okul cep telefonlarıyla ilgili kurallarını yeniden inceliyor.

senses.label: write an opinion
senses.definitionEn: to write an article giving your opinion of a book, film, product or show

examples.en: She reviews new films for a local newspaper.
examples.tr: Yerel bir gazete için yeni filmlerin eleştirilerini yazıyor.

examples.en: Customers reviewed the hotel very positively.

senses.label: officially accept
senses.definitionEn: to officially agree to a plan, request or payment

examples.en: The manager approved my holiday request.
Has the bank approved your loan yet?
The city council didn't approve the new car park.

senses.label: think is good
senses.definitionEn: to think that someone or something is good or right

examples.en: My parents don't approve of my new haircut.
Do you approve of children using phones at school?
examples.tr: Çocukların okulda telefon kullanmasını doğru buluyor musun?

commonMistakesTr: Vurgu ikinci hecededir: /rɪˈdʒekt/.

senses.label: refuse to accept
senses.definitionEn: to refuse to accept, believe in or agree to something

examples.en: She rejected the job offer because the pay was too low.
examples.tr: Maaş çok düşük olduğu için iş teklifini reddetti.

examples.en: My application was rejected twice.
Why did the committee reject our idea?

commonMistakesTr: 'Accept' (kabul etmek) ile 'except' (hariç) telaffuzları yakındır, karıştırılmamalı.

senses.label: agree to take
senses.definitionEn: to agree to take something that is offered, or to agree that something is true

examples.en: Do you accept credit cards?
I'm happy to accept your invitation.
He finally accepted that he was wrong.

commonMistakesTr: 'I am disagree' yanlıştır; 'disagree' bir fiildir: 'I disagree' denir.

senses.label: have a different opinion
senses.definitionEn: to have a different opinion from someone else

examples.en: I'm sorry, but I disagree with you.
My brother and I often disagree about football.
examples.tr: Kardeşimle futbol konusunda sık sık anlaşamayız.

examples.en: Many experts strongly disagree with the new law.
examples.tr: Birçok uzman yeni yasaya kesinlikle karşı çıkıyor.

senses.label: find an answer
senses.definitionEn: to find the answer to a problem or a way to deal with it

examples.en: Can you help me solve this maths problem?
examples.tr: Bu matematik problemini çözmeme yardım eder misin?

examples.en: The police finally solved the mystery.
Talking calmly can solve many arguments.

senses.label: repair
senses.definitionEn: to repair something that is broken or not working

examples.en: Can you fix my bike this weekend?
examples.tr: Bu hafta sonu bisikletimi tamir edebilir misin?

examples.en: A technician came and fixed the washing machine.
examples.tr: Bir teknisyen gelip çamaşır makinesini tamir etti.

examples.en: The developers fixed the bug in the latest update.

senses.label: arrange
senses.definitionEn: to decide or arrange a time, date or price

examples.en: Let's fix a date for the next meeting.
examples.tr: Bir sonraki toplantı için bir tarih belirleyelim.

examples.en: The price was fixed at 200 lira.

senses.label: look to make sure
senses.definitionEn: to look at something to see if it is correct, safe or as it should be

examples.en: I check my email every morning.
Did you check that the door was locked?
examples.tr: Kapının kilitli olduğunu kontrol ettin mi?

examples.en: Please check your answers before you hand in the test.
examples.tr: Lütfen sınavı teslim etmeden önce cevaplarınızı kontrol edin.

senses.label: register at hotel/airport
senses.definitionEn: to arrive and register at a hotel or airport, used with 'in'

examples.en: We checked in at the hotel at three.
examples.noteTr: check in / check out: giriş / çıkış yapmak

examples.en: You must check in two hours before your flight.
examples.tr: Uçuşunuzdan iki saat önce check-in yapmalısınız.

grammarNoteTr: isim olarak: take a test (sınava girmek)

senses.label: try or examine
senses.definitionEn: to use or examine something to see if it works or is good enough

examples.en: We test every phone before it leaves the factory.
examples.tr: Her telefonu fabrikadan çıkmadan önce test ediyoruz.

examples.en: The teacher will test us on irregular verbs tomorrow.
examples.tr: Öğretmen yarın bizi düzensiz fiillerden sınava alacak.

examples.en: Have you tested the new recipe yet?

commonMistakesTr: 'Fabric' 'fabrika' demek değildir; fabrika 'factory' olur.

senses.label: cloth
senses.definitionEn: cloth used for making clothes, curtains and similar things

examples.en: This shirt is made from a light, soft fabric.
examples.tr: Bu gömlek hafif, yumuşak bir kumaştan yapılmış.

examples.en: She bought some colourful fabric to make curtains.
examples.tr: Perde yapmak için renkli kumaş aldı.

examples.en: Which fabric is best for hot weather?
examples.tr: Sıcak hava için hangi kumaş en iyisi?

senses.label: plant and cloth
senses.definitionEn: a soft natural material from a plant, used to make cloth and thread

examples.en: This T-shirt is made of 100% cotton.
examples.tr: Bu tişört yüzde yüz pamuktan yapılmış.

examples.en: Cotton is cooler to wear in summer.
examples.tr: Pamuklu giysi yazın giymek için daha serindir.

examples.en: A lot of cotton is grown in the south of Turkey.

commonMistakesTr: Telaffuzu kısa 'u' ile /wʊl/'dur; 'vul' ya da uzun 'uu' sesiyle okunmaz.

senses.label: hair of sheep
senses.definitionEn: the soft thick hair of sheep, used to make cloth and warm clothes

examples.en: My grandmother knitted me a scarf from wool.
examples.tr: Büyükannem bana yünden bir atkı ördü.

examples.en: This wool sweater keeps me warm in winter.
examples.tr: Bu yün kazak kışın beni sıcak tutuyor.

examples.en: Is this coat made of pure wool?
examples.tr: Bu palto saf yünden mi yapılmış?
